521:t_006:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Still just a preliminary skirmish... I have no intention of risking my life on a battlefield like this.」

521:t_007:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Colonel, fall back! I'll hold them here!」

521:t_007:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$! You're still going on like that!」

521:t_007:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Silence, $$バナージ・リンクス$$! The Colonel is everything to me!」

521:t_007:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You wouldn't understand! When I was in a darkness where I thought being born was a mistake, the Colonel saved me!」

521:t_007:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Blindly believing in $$フル・フロンタル$$ like that is narrowing your possibilities!」

521:t_008:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can't let yourself be bound by what's in front of you! If you lived more freely, people could... go further!」

521:t_009:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The light of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ has changed...!」

521:t_009:2.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Huh...! The spare shield is moving on its own!?」

521:t_010:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Impossible! What is this power!?」

521:t_010:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did he control the shields with the $$サイコ・フィールド$$!?」

521:t_010:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「So this is the possibility he shows.」

521:t_010:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「($$バナージ$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ ability awakens, the $$ユニコーン$$ evolves, and at the same time the $$ユニコーン$$ makes $$バナージ$$ evolve...)」

521:t_010:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「(So this is... the true meaning... of the $$ガンダム$$...)」

521:t_010:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I won't forgive you...! I won't forgive you, $$バナージ$$!」

521:t_010:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You, who denied the Colonel, I will kill with my own hands without fail!」

521:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Leave the rest to us!」

521:t_012:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you're coming, $$シャア$$, $$アムロ$$!」

521:t_012:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Go, $$シャア$$! I'll pin down his movements!」

521:t_012:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I will settle things with the me inside you!」

521:t_013:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Ngh! Is the $$シナンジュ$$ at its limit too!」

521:t_014:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is falling back.」

521:t_014:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「No need to pursue. Getting the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ back on its feet comes first.」

521:t_014:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「At the very least, I could feel that he is a being different from me... the me who stands at the opposite pole.」

521:t_014:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So we're beings who can never be reconciled...」

521:t_014:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「But the one to stop him is not me, I think.」

521:t_014:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't go reaching conclusions on your own and being satisfied with them.」

521:t_015:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I told you. That once $$シャア$$ came back, I would settle things.」

521:t_016:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You will face me, $$シャア$$.」

521:t_016:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is between me and $$ハマーン$$. Everyone, fall back.」

521:t_016:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood. All units, return to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ at once.」

521:t_016:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll see it through to the end, how you live your life.」

521:t_016:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Whatever the result may be, all of you, accept it.」

521:t_016:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So one old tie ends here...」

521:t_017:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You will face me, $$シャア$$.」

521:t_017:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「This is between me and $$ハマーン$$. Everyone, fall back.」

521:t_017:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood. All units, return to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ at once.」

521:t_017:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Whatever the result may be, all of you, accept it.」

521:t_017:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So one old tie ends here...」

521:t_019:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I'm sorry, $$ハマーン$$. I can't let myself be defeated by you yet.」

521:t_019:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But I will settle things in my own way! This is my last battle with you!」

521:t_020:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Do you have the authority to decide that!?」

521:t_020:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then what do you want to do?」

521:t_020:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「Seeing $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$, I felt it... how important it is to give shape to one's feelings.」

521:t_020:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$... Until now, I have been leaning on you.」

521:t_020:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「I presumed, on my own, that you would understand everything without my putting it into words.」

521:t_020:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...You have too many illusions about women.」

521:t_020:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Just as you want to rely on a woman, remember that there are women who want to rely on you.」

521:t_020:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Even if she's the sort the world calls an Iron Lady.」

521:t_020:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Will you walk with me, $$ハマーン$$?」

521:t_020:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I have been waiting all this time for you to say that.」

521:t_021:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Impressive, $$シャア$$! That's how it should be!」

521:t_021:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Let's end this now, $$ハマーン$$.」

521:t_021:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Afraid, are you!? The $$赤い彗星$$ has fallen far!」

521:t_021:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it. ...I want to talk with you.」

521:t_021:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Seeing $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ$$, I felt it... how important it is to give shape to one's feelings.」

521:t_021:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ハマーン$$... Until now, I have been leaning on you.」
